title.orig: The Garden Party and Other Stories
title.en: The Garden Party and Other Stories

origin.en: Written in Europe by a New Zealand author

review.en: Fifteen stories, several set in the New Zealand of the author’s childhood: a family by the sea, a party next to a death, two elderly sisters freed and lost. Mansfield catches a mood in a few lines and leaves the important thing unsaid. She was dying of tuberculosis when the book appeared, and its lightness has an edge because of it.
review.zh: 十五篇小说，好几篇写作者童年时的新西兰：海边的一家人，紧挨着一桩死亡的一场聚会，一对年迈姐妹的解脱与失落。曼斯菲尔德寥寥几笔便抓住一种心绪，又把最要紧的话留着不说。书出版时她已身患肺结核，那份轻盈因此带着锋刃。
